column1: # The Solr trees the cases run (each case.sh's repo=, under GC_TREES): the
# directory name and the branch of the Solr fork (SOLR_FORK, prepare-trees.sh)
# it is checked out at.  It stands on Apache Lucene/Solr branch_8_11 faca81b
# (8.11.4, the last Solr line on Java 8).  The fork's branch is the cluster's
# local gc/solr-final9 0ce3deafed (gc/solr-zk-next 22930889c8, which holds
# gc/solr-body, + gc/solr-zk-doors-r 2346cafecd + gc/solr-zk2-next b2605b6bd7 +
# solr-adhoc-13's workarounds ec89b03ac3 + overseer-lock-leak's workload a55c3f6d78,
# 43e956dcf3 and 82c6114ecc + solr-adhoc-38's workload b31103a39d + the Overseer's
# batching wait 2fc60518c6 (its idle wait back to stock, cd98d779dc) + a view's
# publication door 827b46a609 +
# snapshot-no-active's search d287b1e036 + a planted session expiry b707106739 +
# snapshot-no-active's workload order 7845c97bb1 + makePath's creates 0ce3deafed), and from
# the ZooKeeper causal trace on the local gc/solr-zktrace 8fde6b812c (final9 + SolrZkClient's
# store reads at their calls and watch events into their callbacks), and gc/solr-zktrace2 12d23091d1
# (the automatic cluster's test client keeps its live nodes in node order, CausynthRandom#order, and an
# unbatched Overseer removes each state message's queue item in its own turn, never where
# ZkStateWriter#maybeFlushAfter's nanoTime put it), pushed under this name.  The solr-bug-<jira> trees are
# graphchecker/solr-checks with one old bug put back by hand (solr-buggy-cases.tsv).
# name
lucene-solr-checks
column3: every Solr case: the adapter (CausynthSolrCluster; the message, store-write and store-read doors, a store read's lost reply; ZooKeeper store versions and their JSON content; the node's views of cluster state and aliases), the 12 study checks' markers and the eight bug checks' markers and workloads, with the automatic cluster's determinism patches, the per-collection refresh lock, and the workloads of solr-adhoc-13 and -38 cut after their declared occurrence, the CacheCleaner workaround, the Overseer's batching wait, makePath's creates through create, snapshot-no-active's search as loops, and the expirer a planted SessionExpired calls
